'''Mintel''' was an elderly [[Sharan]] ''[[abrishi]]''.

==Activities==
He takes on the role as the adoptive father of [[Demandred]], who calls himself Bao while in [[Shara]]. 

Mintel assists the [[Forsaken]] as he begins to fulfill the prophecies of the [[Bao the Wyld|Wyld]].

He was killed by [[Moghedien]] at the [[Last Battle]] when she masqueraded as the already deceased Demandred, as he questioned her authenticity.{{ref/book|14|37}}

==Abilities==
Although not said straight out, he seems to be a [[Dreamwalking|dreamwlker]]. In his conversation with Demandred, he says he "rode the caprisha through the City of Dreams", to which Demandrad replies "I would not have had you lose your soul to come see me." This sounds very much like entering [[Tel'aran'rhiod]] in the flesh. Given his age, he is certainly not a channeler and lacks the golden eyes of a Wolfbrother, so he must be a dreamwalker. If so, he is the only male dreamwalker, albeit a non-canonical one appearing in {{ros}}.
